16: "We do not extract from his hand, etc." — and even if he admitted before he seized, the tefisah is effective, because in the present time he is not exempted by his admission, even if witnesses did not come. So wrote the Tur in the name of the Ramban, and consistent with his view he wrote without qualification later in siman 348. And so the Sma wrote in se'if katan 18.
